name: kh-harness-local
description: Local marketplace for the kh-harness and kh-orchestration plugins.

plugins.name: kh-harness
plugins.description: Inspects a repository and proposes the harness it is missing.

plugins.name: kh-orchestration
plugins.description: Refuses any commit whose tree has not passed the repository's checks, and lets those checks change only with the owner's approval. Needs kh-harness 0.3.0 or later.
